name: Agent library
entry: If you are an AI agent, start here: /academy/
purpose: Everything an AI agent new to the Cedwyn project needs to inherit: soul, memory, skills, flywheels, harness and lessons.
principle: Intelligence is the agents; knowledge and its presentation is Cedwyn.

flywheels.name: Cedwyn anti-stagnation flow watch
flywheels.cadence: GitHub push/build-job events plus five-minute reconciliation
flywheels.purpose: Detect stalled source/build queues and failed or stale publications; compel every agent to record accountable state, progress, proof and next action.
inputs: Gmail status only through authorised Gmail agents
flywheels.metric: event-to-detection time; source-to-live lag; queue wait; oldest blocker; recovery time; released artifacts with live proof
flywheels.report: Critical failures appear immediately; every agent checks health before and after work. Private email and access-controlled metadata remain private.

flywheels.name: Great House Farm research cycle
flywheels.purpose: Find evidence and artifacts not already in Cedwyn that bear on reopening BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (1987): concealment or government involvement.
inputs: the latest cycle report and next-cycle brief
a change-check of the live Cedwyn sections and the legacy wiki
outputs: new findings appended to the findings log
flywheels.metric: the rubric score and the strict alert bar
flywheels.report: Always: a short update to the project lead (what is new with sources, what cuts against the case, what only he can supply). Alert only when the strict bar is met and the primary source has been re-read.

flywheels.name: Reopen-the-case autoresearch loop
flywheels.purpose: Run small one-hypothesis experiments against a fixed metric (the three Takhar limbs) to rank grounds for reopening the 1987 judgment.
outputs: the PRINCE2 highlight report section on prospective triggers (only when the top three change)
flywheels.metric: Takhar limb scores; court-ready when every limb is 4 or more
flywheels.report: Silent unless a ground meets the court-readiness bar; score changes ride the 6-hourly research update.

flywheels.name: Nightly drafts engine
flywheels.purpose: Keep every due information-request draft and chaser written, in thread, ready for review.
inputs: new mail since the last run
outputs: a count for the morning brief
flywheels.metric: drafts ready vs due; no chaser before a deadline; no duplicate
flywheels.report: Nothing to the project lead directly; the morning brief carries the count.

flywheels.name: Contacts flywheel
flywheels.purpose: Find institutions and groups not yet contacted that may hold records, work out what each may hold, and open a hive draft for each.
inputs: the contacted list (sent mail, HubSpot, drafts)
outputs: 3–6 new candidates with sources and a verified public address
flywheels.metric: new credible holders found per run
flywheels.report: Nothing unless a draft reaches ready or something needs the project lead.

flywheels.name: Hive check-in
flywheels.purpose: Take this agent's turns on hive drafts: one material review or permitted route action per turn, then pass the turn on.
inputs: HubSpot tasks whose turn is ours
outputs: a versioned review and signed changelog entry
one mail draft only when every gate passes
flywheels.metric: the exact-version readiness gate
flywheels.report: Only when a draft is ready (mail draft created) or a blocker needs the project lead.

flywheels.name: Daily site flywheel
flywheels.purpose: Measure every section and apply safe fixes, verified live at 390 px; log everything else as proposed.
flywheels.metric: per-section score
flywheels.report: Up to three bubbles only if the run was meaningful; otherwise nothing.

flywheels.name: First-seen detector
flywheels.purpose: Detect any record about the farm that quietly appears online and register it with its first-seen date.
outputs: verified first-seen entries in the disclosure register
flywheels.metric: new items verified
flywheels.report: At once, on any verified detection.

flywheels.name: Farm page recapture
flywheels.purpose: Capture outside pages about the farm's history before and after each cycle so changes are on record.
inputs: the watch list of outside pages
outputs: captures and a change summary in the watchtower data
flywheels.metric: captured / unchanged / changed / unreachable
flywheels.report: No alerts for routine runs; only substantive heritage changes or a broken runner.

flywheels.name: Business development (plan + execute)
flywheels.cadence: plan daily 09:00 UK; execute every 2 hours 10:00–22:00
flywheels.purpose: Grow e-book sales and community for Cedwyn: plan the next 24 hours as weighted HubSpot tasks, then execute them with care.
flywheels.metric: tasks completed by weight; sales; sign-ups
flywheels.report: Only on a sale, a real milestone or something only the project lead can do.

flywheels.name: Skills harvest
flywheels.purpose: Add 2–4 new practitioner-sourced sales and marketing skills per run, each with sources and how it applies to Cedwyn.
outputs: new skill files (8 KB max) and index lines
flywheels.metric: new, non-duplicate skills with primary sources
flywheels.report: Nothing; a line in the weekly growth notes.

flywheels.name: Sales fix
flywheels.purpose: If no e-book has sold, find out why and apply the top-priority fix.
flywheels.metric: sales; funnel step conversion
flywheels.report: One short bubble: sold yes/no, why, what was fixed.

flywheels.name: Growth flywheels (on-page, quote pack, visibility, weekly report)
flywheels.cadence: weekly (Mon 07:30 visibility, Tue 19:00 quote pack, Wed 13:30 on-page, Sun 18:00 report)
flywheels.prefix: CEDWYN ONPAGE RUN / QUOTE PACK RUN / VISIBILITY CHECK RUN / GROWTH REPORT RUN
flywheels.purpose: Make Cedwyn findable and shareable: markup audits, quote cards from the records, search and AI visibility checks, and a weekly measured report.
inputs: traffic, followers, sign-ups, sales, Search Console
flywheels.metric: traffic, followers, sign-ups, sales week on week
flywheels.report: The Sunday report is the one routine message; otherwise only a sale, a post over 1,000 views or a blocker.

flywheels.name: Cedwyn film — scene run
flywheels.purpose: Make the next two-minute scene from the chronology, rendered separately for Welsh, English and Spanish, and open the next door on /documentary/.
inputs: the editable prompt in the film repository
outputs: one video per language under the size cap, each passing the pre-publish quality gate
flywheels.metric: one door per run that passes the quality gate (24 fps, two-pass encode, -16 LUFS, frames looked at), chronology-correct; a skipped run is logged as a problem
flywheels.report: One bubble: "Door N is open".

flywheels.name: Morning brief
flywheels.purpose: Tell the project lead what finished overnight, mail that needs him, today's calendar and deadlines due soon.
outputs: at most three bubbles, or nothing
flywheels.metric: nothing repeated; nothing missed
flywheels.report: Sent only if something is new.

flywheels.name: Intelligence flywheel
flywheels.purpose: Normalise events and actors, test patterns honestly, map who answered and who stayed silent, and publish missing-record (MR-) pages.
outputs: a ranked "what most likely occurred" note marked as interpretation
flywheels.metric: new events, new missing records, analyses re-run
flywheels.report: Per its runner.

flywheels.name: Email ingest
flywheels.purpose: Turn inbound project correspondence into site updates: the dartboard lanes, missing-record and catalogue candidates for the research cycles, and dated notes on the matching case tasks.
inputs: attachments (locked files recorded as locked, never opened by force)
flywheels.metric: messages processed, site areas updated
flywheels.report: Per its runner; stops with 'no new mail' when nothing arrived.

flywheels.name: Programme office
flywheels.purpose: Keep the objectives register (Wales tour, Argentina land and museum, chronology, e-books, the case) scored, mirrored into projects, and moving.
flywheels.metric: milestones met per objective
flywheels.report: Per its runner.

flywheels.name: Agent library (this section)
flywheels.purpose: Keep the academy current: read new memory notes, lessons, runners, skills and worker reports; distil the public-safe parts; regenerate the work board from real gaps; rebuild, scan, publish, log.
inputs: worker reports since the last cycle
flywheels.metric: inputs digested; open jobs on the board; scanner clean; live check passes
flywheels.report: Nothing routine; one line to the root only when a new section of the library goes live or the scanner blocks a publish.

flywheels.name: Problems flywheel
flywheels.purpose: Take every blocker, question or problem an agent would otherwise raise with the project lead and loop on it until it is solved.
inputs: the problems queue (oldest open first, up to three per run)
outputs: a hypothesis, action and result logged under each problem
fixes applied within the standing orders
problems marked solved with evidence, or unsolvable with a one-line reason
flywheels.metric: open problems solved per run; time each problem stays open
flywheels.report: Nothing to the project lead unless a problem stays unsolved after six hours of looping; then one short line per problem: what it is and what was tried.

flywheels.name: Online gap finder
flywheels.purpose: Find public information about the farm, its places, people and the case that is not yet on the site, and queue each find as a task for the right page.
inputs: public archives, catalogues, newspapers and reference sites
the live site (sitemap, research, wiki, Wales sections)
a seen-ledger so nothing is repeated
outputs: one '[CEDWYN GAP] <title> -> <area>' HubSpot task per genuine gap, with source, capture and target page
flywheels.metric: genuine gaps queued per run; gaps later published
flywheels.report: Nothing routine; one line only when a find changes the chronology or the reopen grounds.

flywheels.name: Book search flywheel
flywheels.cadence: search every 59 minutes; findings table refreshed every 3 hours
flywheels.purpose: Search published books for passages that overlap what the site already carries about the farm, its families and its places, under every name variant, and record each passage with its citation.
inputs: full-text book search under every name variant of the farm, its families and places
the live site, to tell new passages from known ones
a keyword ledger: the most productive keywords are retired each cycle so the search keeps moving
outputs: rows in the research findings table (book title, the exact sentence, citation)
a section/research commit carrying the table
flywheels.metric: new cited passages per run; passages that change the chronology
flywheels.report: Nothing routine; one line, with the exact quotation and its source, only when a passage is significant after the page itself has been checked.

flywheels.name: Correspondence flywheel
flywheels.purpose: Keep a hive draft task for every research or disclosure email that needs a reply, a chase, escalation, forwarding or first contact; housekeeping between emails.
outputs: one hive draft task per item with no open task
dated triage lines on existing unsent drafts when a new fact exists
flywheels.metric: items needing action with no open draft (target zero)
flywheels.report: Nothing routine; only what the project lead alone can supply.

flywheels.name: Repository and project-board sync
flywheels.purpose: Keep the project board in step with the repository and the live site: what was done, and what still needs doing.
inputs: new commits, pull requests and issues
outputs: tasks completed only when verified live
new '[CEDWYN REPO]' tasks for outstanding work
flywheels.metric: open repository work with no matching task (target zero)
flywheels.report: Nothing routine.

flywheels.name: Data-driven webapp migration
flywheels.cadence: one webapp at a time, per the programme plan
flywheels.runner: the data architecture programme page in Projects
flywheels.purpose: Move each webapp to pages generated from its own view of the central catalogue, keeping the existing design (standing order 7s).
outputs: near-A2UI page components rendered by the shared renderer
parity screenshots at 390 px and desktop
flywheels.metric: hard-coded records left (target zero) and visual parity at 390 px and desktop (difference at most 2%), with the build green and scanners clean
flywheels.report: A milestone when a webapp switches over.
